outcome: Total administered dose of epidural analgesics
Number of times laboring women pressing patient-controlled epidural analgesia (PCEA) pump
cohort: 300 pregnant women admitted by Yulin No.2 Hospital from February 2016 to March 2017 with full-term pregnancy and without any contraindications were enrolled in this study and randomly divided into the study group (n=150) and the control group (n=150).
finding: Ropivacaine had a more rapid onset and greater efficacy compared to bupivacaine when used in CSEA for labor pain, with no significant difference in side effects or impact on maternal and neonatal health.
mod_finding: Newborns from the ropivacaine group scored higher in modified Bromage score compared to the bupivacaine group (P<0.05).
